xref.title: Post-Bauhaus Solo and The Sinister Ducks
xref.body: After the splintering of Bauhaus in 1983, David J initially pursued a solo career before forming a group called The Sinister Ducks, which, however, did not last for a significant period. "at first, he went solo, too. Then he formed a group called The Sinister Ducks, but they didn't last very long."
